question:
52. (i) Find the number of all possible ordered $k$-tuples of non-negative integers $(n_1,n_2,\ldots,n_k)$ such that
\[
\sum_{i=1}^{k}n_i=100.
\]

(ii) Show that the number of all possible ordered 4-tuples of non-negative integers $(n_1,n_2,n_3,n_4)$ such that
\[
\sum_{i=1}^{4}n_i\le100
\]
is $\binom{104}{4}$.
